text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article focused on assessing the mitigation potential and environmental impact of BECCS in Great Britain. While it includes land-use change (LUC) scenarios for bioenergy crop production, its primary objective is not LULC prediction. The LULC scenarios are inputs to the BECCS analysis, not the central research question. The paper does not implement or validate a spatial LULC prediction model; it uses existing yield maps and land constraint masks to define plausible biomass supply areas. It fails the core inclusion criteria of having a primary focus on LULC prediction/simulation and does not report quantitative accuracy metrics for a spatial LULC model. The exclusion criterion "Biomass/bioenergy/carbon studies without LULC change analysis" also applies, as the LULC change is a supporting component, not the main analytical focus.)
